svg.aria-label: Schematic of the ArqueoGal project. The Milky Way seen at an angle, with its halo, thick disc, thin disc and bar drawn as density envelopes, real Gaia red giants around the Sun, and the orbit of one red giant. That star gives an age from TESS oscillations (tasks 2 and 4), an orbit from Gaia astrometry and a chemistry from APOGEE or JANUS (task 3). Starfold returns its population (task 5) and the Galactic model reads the result (task 6). The orbit, chemistry and population stages are tinted, the Galactic model is hatched and the age stage is in outline.
